description: Use this when someone wants a stat for an outbound email, an ad or a slide, e.g. "a stat for my email to a grocery category manager": returns the workspace's stats that fit, best first. Each is a stat and headline from one of its finished social cards (studies with real people), with its source line (e.g. "Real interviews · 48 people · Nov 2026"), the study and a link to the card. Pass the prospect's industry, role and topic; leave them out for the newest stats. Give each stat and headline word for word with its source line beside it; never change a number or add a claim. For quotes use gather_find_quotes; to answer a question use gather_research_answer.

since.description: Only stats from studies that finished on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

topic.description: What the email, ad or slide is about, e.g. "new brands".

name: gather_find_stats
title: Find stats for a campaign
